name: Eli
title: Head Grappling Coach
bio: Eli started grappling while wrestling in high school and was introduced to Brazilian Jiu Jitsu and MMA training his senior year. A black belt in BJJ, and a brown belt in Judo, Eli teaches No Gi and Gi Jiu-Jitsu, along with Wrestling and Judo. He holds a decorated competitive record in all three disciplines, including MMA. Eli has been coaching for over 10 years, and has trained athletes at all levels, from beginners to active UFC fighters.
excerpt: Eli is a world-class coach with extensive experience in professional combat sports.
